import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=0.4208
    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[0]+params[1]*x+params[2]*v+params[3]*np.sin(v)+params[4]*np.sqrt(x)+params[5]*v*v
            +params[6]*C+params[7]*S+params[8]*x*C+params[9]*x*S)
